title: Lean 4 + Mathlib
description: Documented public proof assistant + math library (Lean community (open source)) for the Automated Theorem Explorer capability area.
body:
Lean 4 + Mathlib is a documented proof assistant + math library from Lean community (open source). The dependently-typed proof assistant with Mathlib, the largest formalized mathematics library — used for the Liquid Tensor Experiment and prime number theorem formalizations.

How it works: It works by replaying each proof step against a tiny trusted kernel of inference rules (assumption, modus ponens, and-introduction) and rejecting the proof if any step is unjustified.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
